name: Ir. Dzikri Firmansyah Hakam, S.T., Pg.Dip., M.Sc., Ph.D., CFP®
bio_en:
Ir. Dzikri Firmansyah Hakam, S.T., Pg.Dip., M.Sc., Ph.D., CFP® is the Executive Director of the Institute for Energy, Economics and Finance (IEEF) and an academic at the School of Business and Management, Institut Teknologi Bandung (SBM ITB). He is recognized as an expert in energy economics, finance, electricity policy, infrastructure investment, and energy transition. Through IEEF, he leads the development of strategic research and policy studies focusing on strengthening energy governance, sustainable finance, market design, and accelerating an energy transition that delivers meaningful economic impact for Indonesia. He has a strong professional track record in the energy and power sector, with nearly two decades of experience across industry, government, state-owned enterprises, and academia.

As a researcher and academic, he actively produces internationally recognized scholarly publications, including articles in Scopus Q1-indexed journals in the fields of energy, sustainability, economics, and public policy. He also leads various competitive research projects and grants related to electric vehicles, renewable energy, carbon markets, renewable energy certificates, green hydrogen, and energy transition financing.

He has been entrusted with various strategic projects involving national and international institutions. His engagements include investment feasibility studies for electricity interconnection projects, input-output-based economic impact analysis, carbon market and REC assessments, household gas network studies, and executive capacity-building programs in the energy sector. These roles demonstrate his ability to bridge academic analysis, industry needs, and practical policy recommendations.

He earned his Ph.D. in Economics, with a focus on Energy Economics, Law, and Policy, from the University of Dundee, United Kingdom, through the LPDP scholarship. He also obtained an M.Sc. in Management Science from the University of Dundee through the Chevening Scholarship, a Pg.Dip. in Islamic Economics, Finance, and Banking with Distinction, and an academic background in power engineering from Institut Teknologi Bandung. With his combination of professional experience, academic achievements, international publications, and research leadership, he actively contributes to advancing Indonesia’s energy transition in a more measurable, inclusive, and economically impactful manner.
bio_id:
Ir. Dzikri Firmansyah Hakam, S.T., Pg.Dip., M.Sc., Ph.D., CFP® adalah Direktur Eksekutif Institute for Energy, Economics and Finance (IEEF) dan akademisi di Sekolah Bisnis dan Manajemen Institut Teknologi Bandung (SBM ITB). Ia dikenal sebagai pakar di bidang ekonomi energi, keuangan, kebijakan ketenagalistrikan, investasi infrastruktur, dan transisi energi. Melalui IEEF, ia memimpin pengembangan riset strategis dan kajian kebijakan yang berfokus pada penguatan tata kelola energi, keuangan berkelanjutan, desain pasar, dan percepatan transisi energi yang memberikan dampak ekonomi yang berarti bagi Indonesia. Ia memiliki rekam jejak profesional yang kuat di sektor energi dan ketenagalistrikan, dengan pengalaman hampir dua dekade di industri, pemerintahan, badan usaha milik negara, dan dunia akademik.

Sebagai peneliti dan akademisi, ia aktif menghasilkan publikasi ilmiah bereputasi internasional, termasuk artikel di jurnal terindeks Scopus Q1 di bidang energi, keberlanjutan, ekonomi, dan kebijakan publik. Ia juga memimpin berbagai proyek riset dan hibah kompetitif terkait kendaraan listrik, energi terbarukan, pasar karbon, sertifikat energi terbarukan, hidrogen hijau, dan pembiayaan transisi energi.

Ia telah dipercaya menangani berbagai proyek strategis yang melibatkan lembaga nasional dan internasional, antara lain studi kelayakan investasi proyek interkoneksi listrik, analisis dampak ekonomi berbasis input-output, kajian pasar karbon dan REC, studi jaringan gas rumah tangga, serta program peningkatan kapasitas eksekutif di sektor energi. Peran-peran tersebut menunjukkan kemampuannya menjembatani analisis akademik, kebutuhan industri, dan rekomendasi kebijakan yang aplikatif.

Ia meraih gelar Ph.D. di bidang Ekonomi, dengan fokus Ekonomi, Hukum, dan Kebijakan Energi, dari University of Dundee, Inggris, melalui beasiswa LPDP. Ia juga meraih gelar M.Sc. di bidang Management Science dari University of Dundee melalui Beasiswa Chevening, Pg.Dip. di bidang Ekonomi, Keuangan, dan Perbankan Islam dengan predikat Distinction, serta berlatar belakang pendidikan teknik tenaga listrik dari Institut Teknologi Bandung. Dengan perpaduan pengalaman profesional, capaian akademik, publikasi internasional, dan kepemimpinan riset, ia aktif berkontribusi dalam memajukan transisi energi Indonesia yang lebih terukur, inklusif, dan berdampak secara ekonomi.

name: Yudo Anggoro, S.T.,M.S.M.,Ph.D
role_en: Director, Center for Policy and Public Management, SBM ITB
role_id: Direktur, Center for Policy and Public Management, SBM ITB
bio_en:
Yudo Anggoro, Ph.D. is the Director of the Center for Policy and Public Management at the School of Business and Management, Institut Teknologi Bandung (SBM ITB), as well as an academic and policy strategist in public policy, energy transition, industrial competitiveness, and sustainable investment. He previously led the MBA Jakarta Campus at SBM ITB and initiated flagship programs such as the Energy Executive MBA (ENEMBA) and the Sustainability Executive MBA (STEMBA).

He has extensive experience in policy research, strategic consulting, and corporate governance. He currently serves as a member of the Risk Management and Business Development Committee at PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk, and previously served as a member of the Audit and GCG Committee at PT Transportasi Jakarta. His engagements cover policy studies, energy transition, carbon markets, green steel decarbonization, electricity export, leadership development, and corporate strategy optimization.

As an academic, he actively produces international publications and policy briefs on corporate foresight, ESG policy, renewable energy, smart cities, public governance, and green transition strategies. He earned his Ph.D. in Public Policy from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte as a Fulbright Scholar, and has an academic background in Management Science and Industrial Engineering from Institut Teknologi Bandung. With his combination of academic experience, institutional leadership, policy research, and strategic advisory work, he actively contributes to strengthening public policy, industrial competitiveness, and sustainable transition in Indonesia.
bio_id:
Yudo Anggoro, Ph.D. adalah Direktur Center for Policy and Public Management di Sekolah Bisnis dan Manajemen Institut Teknologi Bandung (SBM ITB), sekaligus akademisi dan ahli strategi kebijakan di bidang kebijakan publik, transisi energi, daya saing industri, dan investasi berkelanjutan. Ia sebelumnya memimpin MBA Kampus Jakarta SBM ITB dan menginisiasi program unggulan seperti Energy Executive MBA (ENEMBA) dan Sustainability Executive MBA (STEMBA).

Ia memiliki pengalaman luas dalam riset kebijakan, konsultasi strategis, dan tata kelola perusahaan. Saat ini ia menjabat sebagai anggota Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Pengembangan Usaha PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk, dan sebelumnya menjabat sebagai anggota Komite Audit dan GCG PT Transportasi Jakarta. Penugasannya mencakup kajian kebijakan, transisi energi, pasar karbon, dekarbonisasi baja hijau, ekspor listrik, pengembangan kepemimpinan, dan optimalisasi strategi korporasi.

Sebagai akademisi, ia aktif menghasilkan publikasi internasional dan policy brief tentang corporate foresight, kebijakan ESG, energi terbarukan, kota cerdas, tata kelola publik, dan strategi transisi hijau. Ia meraih gelar Ph.D. di bidang Kebijakan Publik dari University of North Carolina at Charlotte sebagai penerima beasiswa Fulbright, dan berlatar belakang pendidikan Sains Manajemen serta Teknik Industri dari Institut Teknologi Bandung. Dengan perpaduan pengalaman akademik, kepemimpinan institusi, riset kebijakan, dan peran penasihat strategis, ia aktif berkontribusi memperkuat kebijakan publik, daya saing industri, dan transisi berkelanjutan di Indonesia.

name: Dr. Erman A. Sumirat, SE., MBuss., CSA., CRP., CIB., CWM., Ak.
role_en: Strategic Finance, Investment and Risk Management
role_id: Keuangan Strategis, Investasi, dan Manajemen Risiko
bio_en:
Dr. Erman A. Sumirat, SE., MBuss., CSA., CRP., CIB., CWM., Ak. is an academic, consultant, and senior practitioner in strategic finance, investment, risk management, ESG, and carbon finance. He is active as a lecturer in the MBA program at SBM ITB and Universitas Padjadjaran, and currently serves as a Committee Board Member at Pertamina Hulu Energi, Senior Advisor to the Board of Directors of Telkom Indonesia Group, and Personal Qualification Assessor for SOE executives.

He has more than 25 years of professional experience across various institutions, including Arthur Andersen, Ernst & Young, Accenture, Sindicatum Carbon Capital, Agrinergy, and LAPI ITB. His engagements cover corporate finance advisory, valuation, feasibility studies, ESG financing, carbon credit management, public-private partnership, and executive talent mapping.

He earned his Doctorate in Business Management from Universitas Padjadjaran, Master of Business in Banking and Finance from Monash University, Australia, and Bachelor’s degree in Accounting from Universitas Padjadjaran. With his strong professional experience, certifications, and consulting track record, he actively contributes to strengthening financial governance, risk management, and sustainable financing in Indonesia.
bio_id:
Dr. Erman A. Sumirat, SE., MBuss., CSA., CRP., CIB., CWM., Ak. adalah akademisi, konsultan, dan praktisi senior di bidang keuangan strategis, investasi, manajemen risiko, ESG, dan keuangan karbon. Ia aktif sebagai dosen program MBA di SBM ITB dan Universitas Padjadjaran, dan saat ini menjabat sebagai Anggota Komite di Pertamina Hulu Energi, Penasihat Senior Direksi Telkom Indonesia Group, serta Asesor Kualifikasi Personal bagi eksekutif BUMN.

Ia memiliki lebih dari 25 tahun pengalaman profesional di berbagai institusi, antara lain Arthur Andersen, Ernst & Young, Accenture, Sindicatum Carbon Capital, Agrinergy, dan LAPI ITB. Penugasannya mencakup penasihat keuangan korporasi, valuasi, studi kelayakan, pembiayaan ESG, pengelolaan kredit karbon, kerja sama pemerintah dan badan usaha, serta pemetaan talenta eksekutif.

Ia meraih gelar Doktor Manajemen Bisnis dari Universitas Padjadjaran, Master of Business di bidang Perbankan dan Keuangan dari Monash University, Australia, serta Sarjana Akuntansi dari Universitas Padjadjaran. Dengan pengalaman profesional, sertifikasi, dan rekam jejak konsultasi yang kuat, ia aktif berkontribusi memperkuat tata kelola keuangan, manajemen risiko, dan pembiayaan berkelanjutan di Indonesia.

name: Atika Irawan, S.Mn., M.Sc., Ph.D (Cand.)
role_en: Lecturer, SBM ITB: Finance and Islamic Finance
role_id: Dosen SBM ITB: Keuangan dan Keuangan Syariah
bio_en:
Atika Irawan, S.Mn., M.Sc., Ph.D. (Cand.) is a lecturer at the School of Business and Management, Institut Teknologi Bandung (SBM ITB), and an academic in the fields of finance, Islamic finance, financial literacy, fintech, and business feasibility. She is also a Doctoral Candidate with expertise in the development of financial research and education.

She actively produces publications and research on Islamic banking efficiency, Islamic financing, fintech adoption, corporate social responsibility, financial literacy, and business feasibility studies. One of her notable achievements is being selected as Best Presenter at the Islamic Economic Society United Kingdom 2021 through her research on Islamic banking growth in Indonesia.

She earned her M.Sc. in Islamic Finance and Management from Durham University, United Kingdom, and her Bachelor’s Degree from SBM ITB with a concentration in Finance. She also holds several professional certifications, including Certified Business Analytic Professional, Certified in Islamic Capital Markets and Instruments, Certified Wealth Manager, and Qualified Wealth Planner. With her academic experience, publications, and professional certifications, she actively contributes to the development of financial research and education that is relevant to industry and society.
bio_id:
Atika Irawan, S.Mn., M.Sc., Ph.D. (Cand.) adalah dosen Sekolah Bisnis dan Manajemen Institut Teknologi Bandung (SBM ITB) dan akademisi di bidang keuangan, keuangan syariah, literasi keuangan, teknologi finansial, dan kelayakan bisnis. Ia juga merupakan Kandidat Doktor dengan keahlian dalam pengembangan riset dan pendidikan keuangan.

Ia aktif menghasilkan publikasi dan riset tentang efisiensi perbankan syariah, pembiayaan syariah, adopsi teknologi finansial, tanggung jawab sosial perusahaan, literasi keuangan, dan studi kelayakan bisnis. Salah satu capaiannya adalah terpilih sebagai Best Presenter di Islamic Economic Society United Kingdom 2021 melalui risetnya tentang pertumbuhan perbankan syariah di Indonesia.

Ia meraih gelar M.Sc. di bidang Islamic Finance and Management dari Durham University, Inggris, dan gelar Sarjana dari SBM ITB dengan konsentrasi Keuangan. Ia juga memegang sejumlah sertifikasi profesional, antara lain Certified Business Analytic Professional, Certified in Islamic Capital Markets and Instruments, Certified Wealth Manager, dan Qualified Wealth Planner. Dengan pengalaman akademik, publikasi, dan sertifikasi profesionalnya, ia aktif berkontribusi dalam pengembangan riset dan pendidikan keuangan yang relevan bagi industri dan masyarakat.

name: Achmad Billy Zulqiyami, S.T., S.H., M.H., Ph.D. (Cand.)
role_en: Business Law, Regulation and Policy Studies
role_id: Hukum Bisnis, Regulasi, dan Kajian Kebijakan
bio_en:
Achmad Billy Zulqiyami, S.T., S.H., M.H., Ph.D. (c) is an academic and legal practitioner focusing on business law, contract systems, public regulation, legal due diligence, and policy studies. He is active as a lecturer in Business Law and Contract System at Institut Teknologi Bandung and is currently pursuing his doctoral studies in law at Universitas Padjadjaran.

He has extensive experience in drafting regulations, academic papers, legal opinions, feasibility studies, and legal advisory work for various government institutions, state-owned enterprises, and corporations. His engagements include projects with the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, Ministry of Public Works and Housing, Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning, local governments, ANTAM, Pertamina, Biofarma, Bukit Asam, and various regional-owned enterprises.

With a multidisciplinary background in civil engineering and law, he has the capacity to bridge regulatory, business, infrastructure, and public policy aspects. His experience in legal drafting, due diligence, regulatory development, and corporate studies strengthens his role in supporting legal governance and analysis-based strategic decision-making.
bio_id:
Achmad Billy Zulqiyami, S.T., S.H., M.H., Ph.D. (c) adalah akademisi dan praktisi hukum yang berfokus pada hukum bisnis, sistem kontrak, regulasi publik, uji tuntas hukum, dan kajian kebijakan. Ia aktif sebagai dosen Hukum Bisnis dan Sistem Kontrak di Institut Teknologi Bandung dan saat ini sedang menempuh studi doktoral ilmu hukum di Universitas Padjadjaran.

Ia memiliki pengalaman luas dalam penyusunan regulasi, naskah akademik, pendapat hukum, studi kelayakan, dan pendampingan hukum bagi berbagai instansi pemerintah, badan usaha milik negara, dan korporasi. Penugasannya mencakup proyek bersama Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral, Kementerian Pekerjaan Umum dan Perumahan Rakyat, Kementerian Agraria dan Tata Ruang, pemerintah daerah, ANTAM, Pertamina, Biofarma, Bukit Asam, serta berbagai badan usaha milik daerah.

Dengan latar belakang multidisiplin di bidang teknik sipil dan hukum, ia memiliki kapasitas untuk menjembatani aspek regulasi, bisnis, infrastruktur, dan kebijakan publik. Pengalamannya dalam perancangan peraturan, uji tuntas, pengembangan regulasi, dan kajian korporasi memperkuat perannya dalam mendukung tata kelola hukum dan pengambilan keputusan strategis berbasis analisis.

name: Alif Hijriah, S.Si., M.Si.
bio_en:
Alif Hijriah, S.Si., M.Si. is an expert, educator, and quantitative economic analysis practitioner focusing on mathematical modelling, economic impact analysis, public policy, and educational communication. He currently serves as an Expert in Economic Impact Analysis for Priority Policies at the Coordinating Ministry for Food Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia, an Expert in Economic and Mathematical Analysis at the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, and Technology, and an Expert in Mathematical Analysis at the Regional Development Planning Agency of West Java Province.

He has experience in various strategic consulting projects, including the analysis of the impact of KDKMP on GDP, poverty rates, and the Gini Ratio, which was presented at a Limited Cabinet Meeting at the Presidential Palace of the Republic of Indonesia. His work also includes studies on energy self-sufficiency, the transition from LPG to electric stoves, the impact of road development on GRDP, Vehicle Operating Cost, Value of Time, CO₂ emissions, and the impact of gas imports on the national economy.

In addition to his role as an expert, he is also the President Commissioner of PT Cerebrum Edukanesia Nusantara and is widely known as Alif Towew, an educational content creator in mathematics, physics, and economics. He earned his Master’s degree in Mathematics through the fast-track program at Institut Teknologi Bandung and his Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics from ITB with Cum Laude distinction. With his combination of mathematical expertise, economic analysis, policy consulting experience, and public communication skills, he actively contributes to supporting data-driven policymaking and broad-impact education.
bio_id:
Alif Hijriah, S.Si., M.Si. adalah tenaga ahli, pendidik, dan praktisi analisis ekonomi kuantitatif yang berfokus pada pemodelan matematis, analisis dampak ekonomi, kebijakan publik, dan komunikasi edukatif. Saat ini ia menjabat sebagai Tenaga Ahli Analisis Dampak Ekonomi Kebijakan Prioritas di Kementerian Koordinator Bidang Pangan Republik Indonesia, Tenaga Ahli Analisis Ekonomi dan Matematika di Kementerian Pendidikan Tinggi, Sains, dan Teknologi, serta Tenaga Ahli Analisis Matematika di Badan Perencanaan Pembangunan Daerah Provinsi Jawa Barat.

Ia berpengalaman dalam berbagai proyek konsultasi strategis, termasuk analisis dampak KDKMP terhadap PDB, tingkat kemiskinan, dan Rasio Gini yang dipaparkan dalam Rapat Terbatas Kabinet di Istana Kepresidenan Republik Indonesia. Pekerjaannya juga mencakup kajian swasembada energi, peralihan dari LPG ke kompor listrik, dampak pembangunan jalan terhadap PDRB, Biaya Operasional Kendaraan, Nilai Waktu, emisi CO₂, serta dampak impor gas terhadap perekonomian nasional.

Selain perannya sebagai tenaga ahli, ia juga merupakan Komisaris Utama PT Cerebrum Edukanesia Nusantara dan dikenal luas sebagai Alif Towew, kreator konten edukasi matematika, fisika, dan ekonomi. Ia meraih gelar Magister Matematika melalui program fast-track di Institut Teknologi Bandung dan gelar Sarjana Matematika dari ITB dengan predikat Cum Laude. Dengan perpaduan keahlian matematika, analisis ekonomi, pengalaman konsultasi kebijakan, dan kemampuan komunikasi publik, ia aktif berkontribusi mendukung pembuatan kebijakan berbasis data dan pendidikan yang berdampak luas.

name: Nitha Pricillia, S.E., M.M., Ph.D (Cand.)
bio_en:
Nitha Pricillia is the Program Director of the Center for Risk Management and Sustainability (CRMS) Indonesia and a professional in risk management, governance, compliance, and sustainability. She previously served as Chief Operations Officer at Enterprise Risk Management Academy (ERMA) PTE LTD, Singapore, and is also active as an academic at Parahyangan Catholic University. Through her roles, she contributes to strengthening risk management practices, capacity building, professional certification, and the implementation of risk governance standards within organizations.

As both a practitioner and academic, she has experience in training, competency assessment, and research in governance, risk management, and compliance. She is a Certified Professional Trainer in Risk Management, a Certified Assessor for Risk Management Professional Certification, and holds the Enterprise Risk Management Certified Professional (ERMCP) and Qualified Risk Management Professional (QRMP) certifications. One of her notable achievements is receiving the Best Presentation Award at the International Call for Paper and Conference on Governance, Risk Management and Compliance (ICGRC) 2021.

She earned her Master in Management with a concentration in Risk Management from Parahyangan Catholic University with Cum Laude distinction, and a Bachelor in Economics from Padjadjaran University, also with Cum Laude distinction. She is currently pursuing her doctoral studies at Institut Teknologi Bandung. With her combination of professional experience, certifications, academic achievements, research contributions, and continuous academic development, she actively contributes to strengthening risk governance and organizational sustainability in Indonesia.
bio_id:
Nitha Pricillia adalah Program Director Center for Risk Management and Sustainability (CRMS) Indonesia dan profesional di bidang manajemen risiko, tata kelola, kepatuhan, dan keberlanjutan. Ia sebelumnya menjabat sebagai Chief Operations Officer di Enterprise Risk Management Academy (ERMA) PTE LTD, Singapura, dan juga aktif sebagai akademisi di Universitas Katolik Parahyangan. Melalui peran-perannya, ia berkontribusi memperkuat praktik manajemen risiko, peningkatan kapasitas, sertifikasi profesi, dan penerapan standar tata kelola risiko di berbagai organisasi.

Sebagai praktisi sekaligus akademisi, ia berpengalaman dalam pelatihan, asesmen kompetensi, dan riset di bidang tata kelola, manajemen risiko, dan kepatuhan. Ia adalah Certified Professional Trainer in Risk Management, Certified Assessor untuk Sertifikasi Profesi Manajemen Risiko, serta memegang sertifikasi Enterprise Risk Management Certified Professional (ERMCP) dan Qualified Risk Management Professional (QRMP). Salah satu capaiannya adalah meraih Best Presentation Award pada International Call for Paper and Conference on Governance, Risk Management and Compliance (ICGRC) 2021.

Ia meraih gelar Magister Manajemen dengan konsentrasi Manajemen Risiko dari Universitas Katolik Parahyangan dengan predikat Cum Laude, serta Sarjana Ekonomi dari Universitas Padjadjaran, juga dengan predikat Cum Laude. Saat ini ia sedang menempuh studi doktoral di Institut Teknologi Bandung. Dengan perpaduan pengalaman profesional, sertifikasi, capaian akademik, kontribusi riset, dan pengembangan akademik yang berkelanjutan, ia aktif berkontribusi memperkuat tata kelola risiko dan keberlanjutan organisasi di Indonesia.

name: Khairil Insan Bintang, S.Pd., M.Pd
bio_en:
Khairil Insan Bintang, S.Pd., M.Pd. is a Researcher at the Institute for Energy, Economics and Finance (IEEF), with a focus on economic analysis, data analysis, financial assessment, and quantitative research. He has experience supporting research projects, data management, report preparation, and investment and financial analysis to support strategic decision-making.

He has been involved in various Input-Output Analysis studies for electricity interconnection projects, including Sumatera–Bintan–Batam, Sumatera–Bangka, Sumatera–Java, and Java–Bali. His contributions include sectoral multiplier calculations, economic impact analysis, data management, as well as supporting academic publications and policy recommendations.

He earned his Bachelor of Economic Education and Master of Economic Education from Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia through a fast-track program. He also has expertise in financial modelling, data processing, ESG, risk management, and analytical tools such as Monte Carlo Simulation, SLS Lattice, SPSS, SmartPLS, EViews, STATA, and Crystal Ball. With his combination of research capability, project administration, data analysis, and financial assessment skills, he actively contributes to data-driven economic and policy studies. In addition, he holds several finance-related certifications, including Financial Modeling & Valuation Analyst (FMVA) Certified and Financial Planning and Professional Analyst (FPAP) Certified.
bio_id:
Khairil Insan Bintang, S.Pd., M.Pd. adalah Peneliti di Institute for Energy, Economics and Finance (IEEF) dengan fokus pada analisis ekonomi, analisis data, penilaian keuangan, dan riset kuantitatif. Ia berpengalaman mendukung proyek riset, pengelolaan data, penyusunan laporan, serta analisis investasi dan keuangan untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis.

Ia terlibat dalam berbagai kajian Analisis Input-Output untuk proyek interkoneksi listrik, antara lain Sumatera–Bintan–Batam, Sumatera–Bangka, Sumatera–Jawa, dan Jawa–Bali. Kontribusinya meliputi perhitungan pengganda sektoral, analisis dampak ekonomi, pengelolaan data, serta dukungan terhadap publikasi akademik dan rekomendasi kebijakan.

Ia meraih gelar Sarjana Pendidikan Ekonomi dan Magister Pendidikan Ekonomi dari Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia melalui program fast-track. Ia juga memiliki keahlian dalam pemodelan keuangan, pengolahan data, ESG, manajemen risiko, serta perangkat analisis seperti Monte Carlo Simulation, SLS Lattice, SPSS, SmartPLS, EViews, STATA, dan Crystal Ball. Dengan perpaduan kemampuan riset, administrasi proyek, analisis data, dan penilaian keuangan, ia aktif berkontribusi dalam kajian ekonomi dan kebijakan berbasis data. Selain itu, ia memegang sejumlah sertifikasi di bidang keuangan, antara lain Financial Modeling & Valuation Analyst (FMVA) dan Financial Planning and Professional Analyst (FPAP).

name: Sophia Roosma Hardeny, S.T., MBA.
bio_en:
Sophia Roosma Hardeny, S.T., MBA. is a senior professional in construction management, project control, civil-architectural engineering, and project risk management. She has more than 20 years of experience in plant and non-plant building construction projects, particularly in the power plant and oil and gas sectors.

She currently serves at Sumitomo Corporation on the Central Java 2x1000 MW Coal Fired Power Plant project, with experience as Site Manager for the Warranty Period, Civil, Architecture & Offshore Division Manager, and Chief Engineer. Previously, she was also involved in various strategic projects with PT Bhimasena Power Indonesia, PT Rekayasa Industri, PT Tripatra Constructors & Engineers, and PT Paiton Energy.

With an architectural engineering background from Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS) and extensive experience in energy infrastructure projects, she has strong capabilities in construction management, multidisciplinary coordination, project control, and the implementation of HSE standards. She actively contributes to ensuring that project execution aligns with established technical, quality, safety, and design standards.
bio_id:
Sophia Roosma Hardeny, S.T., MBA. adalah profesional senior di bidang manajemen konstruksi, pengendalian proyek, teknik sipil-arsitektur, dan manajemen risiko proyek. Ia memiliki pengalaman lebih dari 20 tahun dalam proyek konstruksi bangunan plant dan non-plant, khususnya di sektor pembangkit listrik serta minyak dan gas.

Saat ini ia bertugas di Sumitomo Corporation pada proyek PLTU Jawa Tengah 2x1000 MW, dengan pengalaman sebagai Site Manager untuk Masa Garansi, Manajer Divisi Sipil, Arsitektur & Offshore, serta Chief Engineer. Sebelumnya, ia juga terlibat dalam berbagai proyek strategis bersama PT Bhimasena Power Indonesia, PT Rekayasa Industri, PT Tripatra Constructors & Engineers, dan PT Paiton Energy.

Dengan latar belakang pendidikan teknik arsitektur dari Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS) dan pengalaman luas dalam proyek infrastruktur energi, ia memiliki kemampuan kuat dalam manajemen konstruksi, koordinasi multidisiplin, pengendalian proyek, dan penerapan standar K3L. Ia aktif berkontribusi memastikan pelaksanaan proyek sesuai dengan standar teknis, mutu, keselamatan, dan desain yang telah ditetapkan.

name: Anisya Nurfitri K., S.Pd., M.S.M
role_en: Project Manager and Research Assistant, IEEF
role_id: Manajer Proyek dan Asisten Peneliti, IEEF
bio_en:
Anisya Nurfitri K., S.Pd., M.S.M. is a Project Manager and Research Assistant at the Institute for Energy, Economics, and Finance (IEEF), with a focus on project management, management research, economic analysis, community development, and consumer behavior. She has experience managing research and consulting projects from planning, data collection, and analysis to report preparation and academic publication.

She has been involved in various strategic projects with LAPI–PGN, the Asian Development Bank, PLN, and SBM ITB, including studies on carbon markets and Renewable Energy Certificates, household gas network feasibility studies, strategic corporate project reviews, the development of PLN Research and Development Center’s long-term corporate plan, and research on electric vehicle consumer behavior. She also supports several research grants related to ASEAN electricity interconnection, the transition from LPG to gas networks, RECs, electric vehicle adoption, and ESG.

She earned her Master of Science in Management from Universitas Padjadjaran with a GPA of 4.00/4.00 and was named Best Graduate of the Master of Science in Management Program at FEB Unpad. Previously, she completed her Bachelor’s degree in Office Management Education at Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia and received the PPA Scholarship. With her experience in research, project management, data analysis, and academic publication, she actively contributes to data-driven studies and impactful policy development.
bio_id:
Anisya Nurfitri K., S.Pd., M.S.M. adalah Project Manager dan Asisten Peneliti di Institute for Energy, Economics, and Finance (IEEF) dengan fokus pada manajemen proyek, riset manajemen, analisis ekonomi, pengembangan masyarakat, dan perilaku konsumen. Ia berpengalaman mengelola proyek riset dan konsultasi mulai dari perencanaan, pengumpulan data, dan analisis hingga penyusunan laporan dan publikasi akademik.

Ia terlibat dalam berbagai proyek strategis bersama LAPI–PGN, Asian Development Bank, PLN, dan SBM ITB, termasuk kajian pasar karbon dan Renewable Energy Certificate, studi kelayakan jaringan gas rumah tangga, tinjauan proyek strategis korporasi, penyusunan rencana jangka panjang perusahaan Pusat Penelitian dan Pengembangan PLN, serta riset perilaku konsumen kendaraan listrik. Ia juga mendukung sejumlah hibah riset terkait interkoneksi listrik ASEAN, peralihan dari LPG ke jaringan gas, REC, adopsi kendaraan listrik, dan ESG.

Ia meraih gelar Magister Sains Manajemen dari Universitas Padjadjaran dengan IPK 4,00/4,00 dan dinobatkan sebagai Wisudawan Terbaik Program Magister Sains Manajemen FEB Unpad. Sebelumnya, ia menyelesaikan pendidikan Sarjana Pendidikan Manajemen Perkantoran di Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia dan menerima Beasiswa PPA. Dengan pengalamannya di bidang riset, manajemen proyek, analisis data, dan publikasi akademik, ia aktif berkontribusi dalam kajian berbasis data dan pengembangan kebijakan yang berdampak.

name: Fadhil Nurilman Muhammad, S.M., MBA.
role_id: Kajian Dampak Ekonomi dan Studi Kelayakan
bio_en:
Fadhil Nurilman Muhammad, S.M., MBA. is an entrepreneur and business and economic study consultant with a focus on economic impact evaluation, feasibility studies, cost-benefit analysis, and input-output modelling. He has experience as a project-based Socio-economic Researcher at ITB and STEI ITB, as well as a Regional Economic and Business Consultant at PT Ripta Jagabhumi Nusantara.

He has been involved in various strategic studies, including socio-economic impact analysis for interregional electricity interconnection projects, Leontief-based Input-Output modelling, feasibility studies, commercial and financial due diligence, and regional economic studies for strategic projects such as Indonesia’s New Capital City and regional asset development. In addition, he has entrepreneurial experience as the Founder and Owner of Okosan Gyoza and Bakmie Karet Ayam Kampung H. Man.

He earned his MBA from the School of Business and Management, Institut Teknologi Bandung (SBM ITB), with a concentration in Finance, and his Bachelor’s degree in Management from Universitas Widyatama. One of his notable achievements is winning 1st Place in the MBA ITB Business and Marketing Plan Competition 2023. With his combination of expertise in economic analysis, finance, feasibility studies, and business development, he actively contributes to supporting data-driven strategic decision-making and investment feasibility assessment.
bio_id:
Fadhil Nurilman Muhammad, S.M., MBA. adalah wirausahawan dan konsultan kajian bisnis dan ekonomi dengan fokus pada evaluasi dampak ekonomi, studi kelayakan, analisis biaya-manfaat, dan pemodelan input-output. Ia berpengalaman sebagai Peneliti Sosial Ekonomi berbasis proyek di ITB dan STEI ITB, serta sebagai Konsultan Ekonomi dan Bisnis Regional di PT Ripta Jagabhumi Nusantara.

Ia terlibat dalam berbagai kajian strategis, termasuk analisis dampak sosial ekonomi proyek interkoneksi listrik antarwilayah, pemodelan Input-Output berbasis Leontief, studi kelayakan, uji tuntas komersial dan keuangan, serta kajian ekonomi regional untuk proyek strategis seperti Ibu Kota Nusantara dan pengembangan aset daerah. Selain itu, ia memiliki pengalaman berwirausaha sebagai Pendiri dan Pemilik Okosan Gyoza serta Bakmie Karet Ayam Kampung H. Man.

Ia meraih gelar MBA dari Sekolah Bisnis dan Manajemen Institut Teknologi Bandung (SBM ITB) dengan konsentrasi Keuangan, serta gelar Sarjana Manajemen dari Universitas Widyatama. Salah satu capaiannya adalah meraih Juara 1 MBA ITB Business and Marketing Plan Competition 2023. Dengan perpaduan keahlian di bidang analisis ekonomi, keuangan, studi kelayakan, dan pengembangan bisnis, ia aktif berkontribusi mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis berbasis data dan penilaian kelayakan investasi.

name: Ihda Farhatun Nisak, S.Pd., M.M.
bio_en:
Ihda Farhatun Nisak, S.Pd., M.M. is a Researcher at the Institute for Energy, Economics and Finance (IEEF) and a lecturer at Institut Ekonomi dan Digital LPKIA. She has expertise in management, marketing, digital customer experience, quantitative research, and data analysis. As a lecturer, she teaches research methodology and statistics.

She has research experience in artificial intelligence in digital services, customer engagement, online repurchase intention, digital marketing, and collaborative governance in poverty alleviation. She is also active in academic publications and presentations at national and international forums, including topics related to digital customer experience, gamification, and digital investment behavior.

She earned her Master’s degree in Management from Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia with early completion, as well as a Bachelor’s degree in Business Education with Best Graduate distinction. With her combination of academic experience, research, publications, data analysis, and digital communication skills, she actively contributes to data-driven studies, policy development, and digital economic transformation.
bio_id:
Ihda Farhatun Nisak, S.Pd., M.M. adalah Peneliti di Institute for Energy, Economics and Finance (IEEF) dan dosen di Institut Ekonomi dan Digital LPKIA. Ia memiliki keahlian di bidang manajemen, pemasaran, pengalaman pelanggan digital, riset kuantitatif, dan analisis data. Sebagai dosen, ia mengampu mata kuliah metodologi penelitian dan statistika.

Ia berpengalaman meneliti kecerdasan artifisial dalam layanan digital, keterlibatan pelanggan, niat pembelian ulang daring, pemasaran digital, dan tata kelola kolaboratif dalam pengentasan kemiskinan. Ia juga aktif menulis publikasi akademik dan menjadi pemakalah di forum nasional dan internasional, dengan topik antara lain pengalaman pelanggan digital, gamifikasi, dan perilaku investasi digital.

Ia meraih gelar Magister Manajemen dari Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia dengan masa studi lebih cepat, serta gelar Sarjana Pendidikan Bisnis dengan predikat Wisudawan Terbaik. Dengan perpaduan pengalaman akademik, riset, publikasi, analisis data, dan kemampuan komunikasi digital, ia aktif berkontribusi dalam kajian berbasis data, pengembangan kebijakan, dan transformasi ekonomi digital.
